title: The State of Advertising MCPs in 2026

facts.fact: Seven of the 11 major ad platforms in the review have launched, piloted, or announced an official Ads MCP server.
facts.quote: Seven of the 11 major ad platforms in this review have launched, piloted, or announced an official Ads MCP server.

facts.fact: Only four of the 11 reviewed platforms' Ads MCPs can be used today without joining an alpha or waitlist, according to the page's review.
facts.quote: Only four can be used today without joining an alpha or waitlist, and just three offer meaningful campaign writes.

facts.fact: Only three of the reviewed platforms' official Ads MCPs offer meaningful campaign writes, according to the page's review.
facts.quote: and just three offer meaningful campaign writes.

facts.fact: The page defines an Ads MCP as official only when the ad platform publishes, operates, or formally announces it.
facts.quote: an Ads MCP is official only when the ad platform publishes, operates, or formally announces it.

facts.fact: The page uses five maturity labels to classify Ads MCP status: Available, Open beta, Open pilot, Alpha or announced, and No official MCP found.
Google's official Ads MCP server is read-only and exposes three core tools for listing accessible customers, running searches, and retrieving resource metadata.
facts.quote: currently exposes three core tools for listing accessible customers, running searches, and retrieving resource metadata.

facts.fact: Google's official Ads MCP server cannot create a campaign, pause an ad, change a bid, or update a budget.
facts.quote: it cannot create a campaign, pause an ad, change a bid, or update a budget.

facts.fact: Meta introduced its official Ads AI connectors in open beta on April 29, 2026.
TikTok launched its Agentic Hub on June 30, after announcing Ads MCP and agent skills at TikTok World.
Amazon's official Ads MCP server entered open beta on February 2, 2026.
Amazon's official Ads MCP server can create, update, and delete campaigns, run reports, manage account settings, and access billing and financial data.
facts.quote: It can create, update, and delete campaigns, run reports, manage account settings, and access billing and financial data.

facts.fact: Amazon's Ads MCP beta is available to Amazon Ads partners with active API credentials, not every advertiser with a console login.
facts.quote: the beta is available to Amazon Ads partners with active API credentials, not every advertiser with a console login.

facts.fact: Microsoft announced its Advertising MCP server as an open pilot on June 17, 2026.
facts.quote: as an open pilot on June 17, 2026.

facts.fact: Microsoft's Advertising MCP server provides read-only access at launch to campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, and performance metrics.
facts.quote: provides read-only access to campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, and performance metrics

facts.fact: Pinterest announced its official MCP work on June 17 with alpha partners including agencies and ad-tech platforms.
facts.quote: on June 17 with alpha partners including agencies and ad-tech platforms.

facts.fact: Snap said on June 18 that it was opening its ads platform to third-party AI agents through MCP.
